prompt:
Premium cartoon slot-machine symbol, a single object, centred, filling about 85% of a square frame, on a fully transparent background. Style: polished high-end cartoon illustration matching a modern premium slot game - bold confident black ink outline with varied line weight, rich cel shading with soft gradients, glossy specular highlights, fine material texture, chunky appealing exaggerated shapes, clean saturated colours, readable at small size. Lighting: warm amber key light from the upper left in front of the object; thin hot neon-red rim light along the right and lower-right edges; soft cool night-blue fill; core shadows lower right. No background, no ground shadow, no frame, no border, no text unless stated.

The object: a bold cobalt-blue metal kerosene jerry can with a chrome spout cap, a chunky handle and an embossed X pattern on its side, a few scuffs showing bare metal.
